mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT r.* FROM studyroom_runs r JOIN study_rooms s ON s.id=r.room_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} AND current_run_id=#{runId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE id=#{fragmentId} AND run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM studyroom_request_keys WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND operation=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE unit_id=#{unitId} AND (step_id IS NULL OR fragment_order>#{fragmentOrder})
SELECT unit_id FROM studyroom_completed_knowledge WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND unit_id=#{unitId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_learning_progress WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_learning_progress SET unit_id=#{unitId},fragment_id=#{fragmentId},completed=#{completed},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{runId}
UPDATE study_rooms SET current_step_id=#{stepId},last_learning_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE current_run_id=#{runId} AND user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE studyroom_runs SET state_version=state_version+1 WHERE id=#{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision),0)+1 FROM studyroom_fragment_versions WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_fragment_versions WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND revision=#{revision} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE job_key=#{jobKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET fragment_id=#{fragmentId},priority=300, attempt=CASE WHEN status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED') THEN attempt+1 ELSE attempt END, status='QUEUED',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,failure_code=NULL,failure_message=NULL,next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{jobId}
